text:
jess_sales: AuroraCare needs a compact compliance bundle for their POC: SOC2 scope page, ISO27001 crypto excerpt, KMS separation diagram, and a signed pen-test attestation. Theyneed it by tomorrow morning.
omar_se: I can produce the KMS diagram and a short note about tenant isolation. Do they want HSM details or just logical separation?
jess_sales: Logical separation only. Also ask for tenant-id so we can stash artifacts in a scoped S3 folder.
aurora_pm: tenant-id is auroracare-poc-2; contact is infra@auroracare.io.
lina_compliance: I'll extract the SOC2 scope and the ISO A.10 crypto excerpt and redact internal runbooks. ETA 6 hours.
ben_security: Pen-test attestation: we have a standard attestation template. Legal needs to confirm before signing. @legal_bot can you kick off review?
legal_bot: automated: NDA/DPA check: NDA present, DPA signed. Manual legal review assigned to @jess_sales. Expect sign-off within 8 business hours.
jess_sales: I'll reply to legal with scope and attach the customer name.
ben_security: Note: for KMS separation the platform uses /redwood/platform/* and customer keys are /redwood/customers/<tenant-id>/*. I'll add a one-slide diagram and a line about backup encryption.
omar_se: Dropping a tiny ASCII for approval:
```
Client -> Gateway -> Inference Pool
           |         |
     Customer KMS  Platform KMS
```
omar_se: I'll convert to PNG and upload to s3.
lina_compliance: Upload paths will be s3://redwood-compliance/auroracare/poc-bundle/{soc2.pdf,iso-a10.pdf,kms-diagram.png,pen-attest.pdf}. I'll mark pen-attest as pending-signature.
jess_sales: Pricing note: they asked if dedicated tenancy affects POC pricing. Ballpark for one small dedicated node for a week is ~$3k. I'll confirm with finance if they request reserved terms.
aurora_pm: They want hosted with isolated tenancy. Please include setup ETA.
ben_security: Setup for isolation + network peering ~48 hours after CIDR & approvals.
jess_sales: OK assembling bundle now; will send to infra@auroracare.io once legal signs. Closing after send. :white_check_mark:
